name: Bus Breakdown and Delays
description:
This dataset contains records of school bus breakdowns and delays, with 5,000 sampled rows and 21 columns. Each row describes a single incident, including the school year, a unique breakdown ID, run type, bus number, route number, the stated reason for the delay or breakdown, and the schools serviced. It also records when the incident occurred and when the record was created, the borough, the bus company name, how long the delay lasted, and the number of students on the bus. Additional fields indicate whether the contractor notified schools and parents, whether the Office of Pupil Transportation was alerted, when parties were informed, an incident number, the last update time, whether the event was a breakdown or a late run, and whether the students were school-age or pre-K.

The data can be used to analyze the frequency and causes of bus breakdowns and delays across school years, boroughs, companies, and routes; to measure how quickly contractors and schools are notified; and to
